title: sudo-exec JSON
description: Success payload of `ssh-cli sudo-exec <VPS> <COMMAND> --json` on a single host. Failures use error-envelope.schema.json instead. Carries no `event` discriminator. With more than one command (`--step`) one document is printed per step, each with the extra fields `step` and `command`.

target_resolved.description: Canonical name of the host the command ran on (Explicit Target Designation). Bind new consumers here

target_source.description: canonical name for how target_resolved was designated

host_resolved.description: Compatibility alias of target_resolved (0.5.5 spelling), written from the same value and never an independent source of truth. Always present on this event, because a command only runs after a target is designated; the error envelope omits it entirely when the failure preceded target resolution.

host_source.description: Compatibility alias of target_source (0.5.5 spelling). Bind new consumers to target_source instead.

active_fallback.description: True when target_resolved came from the active marker (--use-active) rather than argv. Redundant with target_source on purpose: a shell pipeline can branch on a boolean without knowing how the enum is spelled.

exit_code.description: Remote exit code, always present and null when the remote side reported none

step.description: Only when several commands ran (`--step`): the 0-based index of the step this document reports. A single-command run never carries it.

command.description: Only when several commands ran (`--step`): the command text of the step this document reports. A single-command run never carries it.
